item.text:
Created [openai_client.py](/workspace/openai_client.py).

It uses only the standard library, reads `OPENAI_API_KEY`, enforces HTTPS, avoids logging prompts/API bodies, supports `respond()` and `send_prompt()`, and can read a prompt securely from stdin.

Verified syntax and Responses output-text extraction offline. No session `.jsonl` file was present in `/workspace`.
